<p class="page-lead">Every homework is <strong>individual</strong>. You submit three pieces on Canvas: a runnable R notebook, at most six slides, and a video of at most five minutes. The slides and the video should tell the same story as the notebook: what they are trying to decide, how you approached it, what you found, and what you would do.</p>

<p>Homework 1 through Homework 4 are posted below. Submit on <strong>Canvas</strong> only (not this site). Due dates are in the table.</p>

## Package (every HW)

1. **R notebook** — analysis must run  
2. **At most six slides** — same story as the notebook  
3. **≤ 5:00 video** — camera on; I need to see you delivering. If you read the slides, that piece is a zero. AI may help you prepare; it must not deliver the video.  

Submit on **Canvas** only (not this site).

## AI

AI is allowed on homework if you disclose it (Yellow level, when the assignment allows it). You must run the code and be able to explain the important parts of how you reached the decision. If you hide AI use, or you cannot explain the work in the video, or I suspect you used AI inappropriately, I will ask you to present in person. Depending on how you handle the questions in person, the grade on that homework can go as low as 0, and you may be reported for an academic integrity violation. See [Syllabus](../syllabus.qmd).
